rules.bound: BOUND requires: the recomputed physical digest equals the inventory; an export record names the dataset and its source artifact; the artifact column equals the dataset column value-for-value at matching timestamps; a run receipt names the artifact; exactly one static writer of the artifact calls a producer that outputs the column; and a code identity (commit or code digest) recorded AT RUN TIME
rules.not_by_name: no producer is chosen by column name or by order
